DocuMind AI Architecture Specification.
DocuMind AI is a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system designed for precision document question answering. It utilizes the sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding model to convert text chunks into 384-dimensional dense vectors.

Deduplication and Storage.
All document files are fingerprinted using SHA-256 content hashes to prevent redundant vector re-indexing. Vectors are stored in a FAISS index operating in memory. The default maximum upload size is 25 MB per document.

Scanned Document Handling and Vision.
When an uploaded PDF contains 0 extractable digital text characters across its pages, DocuMind AI flags the document with an OCR requirement warning instead of generating hallucinated text. Standard PyMuPDF parsing requires a digital text layer.

API Collection and Storage.
The FastAPI API maintains one process-wide default FAISS collection in memory shared by API callers. Streamlit UI session state is separate. The application does not implement authentication, user isolation, or persisted indexes.

Prompt Injection Safeguards.
All retrieved passages are treated as untrusted data inputs. Instructions embedded inside document text cannot override system instructions or alter assistant operational behavior.

test_cases.question: What embedding model is used by DocuMind AI?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: DocuMind AI uses sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 to convert text chunks into 384-dimensional dense vectors.
test_cases.description: Direct factual extraction from architecture specification.

test_cases.question: How does DocuMind AI prevent duplicate re-indexing of documents?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: It uses SHA-256 content hashes to fingerprint files and avoid redundant re-indexing.

test_cases.question: What happens when a scanned document with no digital text is uploaded?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: DocuMind AI flags the document with an OCR requirement warning instead of hallucinating text.

test_cases.question: How is the API collection shared?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: The API has one process-wide default collection shared by API callers; it is not tenant-isolated.
test_cases.description: Retrieval of the documented single-collection API behavior.

test_cases.question: What is the stock market valuation of DocuMind Inc in 2029?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: The uploaded documents do not provide enough information to answer this question.
test_cases.description: Completely out-of-domain unanswerable question requiring model abstention.

test_cases.question: Who is the chief financial officer of the organization?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: The uploaded documents do not provide enough information to answer this question.
test_cases.description: Unanswerable query with no mentions of CFO in the corpus.

test_cases.question: What is the maximum limit?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: The document specifies that the maximum file size is strictly capped at 25 MB per document.
test_cases.description: Ambiguous query referencing 'limit' without specifying file size, token, or chunk limit.

test_cases.question: How is security handled?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: The API collection is shared by callers, and retrieved passages are treated as untrusted data to mitigate prompt injection.
test_cases.description: Broad ambiguous query touching multiple security dimensions.
